description: Generated JavaScript file for jQuery File Upload Plugin, including feature detection, widget definition, and chunked upload support.

classes.name: blueimp.widget
classes.description: jQuery UI widget for file upload functionality with support for drag-and-drop, progress, and chunked uploads.

methods.name: getDragHandler
methods.description: Creates drag event handlers for dragover, dragenter, and dragleave events.

methods.name: _initProgressObject
methods.description: Initializes progress tracking object.

methods.name: _initResponseObject
methods.description: Initializes response tracking object.

methods.name: _onProgress
methods.description: Handles upload progress events, updates progress data, and triggers progress events.

methods.name: _chunkedUpload
methods.description: Uploads a file in multiple chunks, supporting resumable uploads.

methods.name: _beforeSend
methods.description: Prepares upload options and progress tracking before sending.

methods.name: _onDone
methods.description: Handles successful upload completion.

methods.name: _onFail
methods.description: Handles upload failure.

methods.name: _onAlways
methods.description: Handles completion of upload request, success or failure.

methods.name: _onSend
methods.description: Manages the sending of files, including chunked uploads and promise handling.

methods.name: _onAdd
methods.description: Handles files added to the upload queue, including batching and triggering upload.

methods.name: _replaceFileInput
methods.description: Replaces the file input element to reset its state.

methods.name: _handleFileTreeEntry
methods.description: Processes a file system entry, supporting directories and files.

methods.name: _handleFileTreeEntries
methods.description: Processes multiple file system entries.

methods.name: _getDroppedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves files from a drag-and-drop event, including directory entries.

methods.name: _getSingleFileInputFiles
methods.description: Gets files from a single file input element, normalizing for browser differences.

methods.name: _getFileInputFiles
methods.description: Gets files from multiple file input elements.

methods.name: _onChange
methods.description: Handles change event on file input elements.

methods.name: _onPaste
methods.description: Handles paste events for file uploads.

methods.name: _onDrop
methods.description: Handles drop events for drag-and-drop file uploads.

methods.name: _initEventHandlers
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for drag, drop, paste, and input change.

methods.name: _destroyEventHandlers
methods.description: Removes event handlers.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets widget options, reinitializing if necessary.

methods.name: _initSpecialOptions
methods.description: Initializes special options like fileInput, dropZone, and pasteZone.

methods.name: _getRegExp
methods.description: Converts string to RegExp object.

methods.name: _isRegExpOption
methods.description: Checks if an option value is a RegExp string.

methods.name: _initDataAttributes
methods.description: Initializes options from HTML data attributes.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Widget initialization, setting up data attributes, event handlers, and state.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Returns number of active uploads.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Returns current upload progress data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds files to the upload queue and initiates upload if autoUpload is enabled.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Starts uploading files, returning a promise.
